info.title: Follow the Rupee: Backend
info.description:
Pre-Payment Audit Gate + Citizen Rupee Receipt for Mumbai monsoon road repairs (synthetic dataset).

Every number is computed by the pipelines (`audit_engine/run_audit.py`, `scorecard_planner/run_pipeline.py`); endpoints only select and shape. Flags are labelled *Needs Explanation* or *Recoverable under DLP*, and every flag carries `evidence_row_ids`. Amounts are whole rupees (INR). No login wall for citizens: an anonymous account (POST /api/citizens) gives a bearer token for 'my reports'. Officers sign in at POST /api/admin/login.

post.summary: Citizen question -> plain-language answer (Claude, template fallback)
post.description:
Resolves the text like /api/lookup, then Claude rewrites the precomputed facts as a 3-5 sentence answer in the
requested language. Falls back to a template if Claude is slow/unavailable or cites an ID not in the facts.

post.summary: Submit citizen report (server sets tracker status)
post.description:
View 4 report. The server resolves the road (road_id -> location within 500 m -> landmark/text), links the latest
matching work order, detects a duplicate (same road + issue in 7 days) and sets the status: matched_to_contract when
a road matched, else reported. Officers move it on (payment hold, contractor notice, ...); clients cannot set it.
With `Authorization: Bearer <citizen token>` the report is saved to that citizen (GET /api/me/reports).
contact_phone is stored privately and never returned.

No login: the app calls this once, stores `token` and sends `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on citizen calls.
The token is shown only here (the database keeps its hash). `phone` is optional and never returned.

post.summary: Record a notice to the responsible contractor
post.description:
Contractor = the contractor of the report's flagged bill; without a flag, the linked work order's contractor,
else the road's latest surface-repair contractor, else its latest contractor. Without `message`, the notice is drafted from the report's flag via the
draft-notice logic (Claude, template fallback). The notice is RECORDED (delivery: recorded), not sent. Moves the
report to contractor_notified when that transition is allowed; closed reports -> 409.

get.summary: Monthly contractor scorecards: separate speed / SLA / durability / cost ranks
get.description:
One block per month; every contractor-month carries four independent ranks (null when its own sample
is below the methodology minimum, with the reason in `rank_eligibility`), known/missing denominators,
descriptive context, and the work-order IDs used as evidence. No composite score.

Subject: Defect notice for work order WO25-01994 on Sion Trombay Road (RD0240), Ward M/W

Work: Paver blocks relaid, cost ₹1,48,557, completed on 2025-09-03.
Finding: Paver blocks relaid billed at ₹148,557 on RD0240, which is under the original contractor's Defect Liability Period (last resurfaced 2024-04-03).
Amount at stake: ₹1,48,557.
The road is under the Defect Liability Period until 2027-04-03.

You are requested to submit a written explanation and, where the work falls within the Defect Liability Period, to rectify the defect at your own cost, within 15 days of this notice.

Evidence rows: WO25-01994, RD0240

Executive Engineer (Roads), Ward M/W
